analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for the third consecutive session. RSI remains in oversold territory, but the gap with the 20-day moving average ($1,557,850) is significant at -13.33%. ADX shows a clear trend at 29.4, but -DI (42.1) is dominant over +DI (14.1), indicating strong downward pressure. The price is at 32.1% of its 52-week range, suggesting potential for further decline.
